message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a red background. At the top, "TEMPO" is written in large, black serif letters. Centered is a stylized illustration of a man with short black hair, tan skin, and a white t-shirt. He looks downward with a focused expression, his hands engaged in a physical activity. He holds a dark gray iron with his right hand, pressing it onto a checkered red, white, and blue cloth. His left hand pulls the edge of a white, curved shape that resembles a shirt collar resting on the fabric. The man's arms and face are rendered with bold, dark blue shadows.

Large white text to the right reads "MENUJU LAGA BERIKUTNYA". Below this, smaller white text block contains Indonesian sentences beginning with "JOKOWI MERANGKUL KAWAN DAN LAWAN." At the bottom right, there is a white barcode, "30 APRIL - 6 MEI 2018", and "RP 45.000". Additional small text includes "NAMA-NAMA RAIB DALAM PERKARA E-KTP" and "INVESTIGASI: PARA PENCEMAR CITARUM" at the very top. Translucent black lines suggest shadows cast by the man across the checkered surface.
